EC2: Body mass index (BMI) < 18.5 kg/m2 or > 25 kg/m2.
EC3: Presence of any infertility factor [NOT] other than anovulatory PCOS.
EC4: Previous history of ovarian surgery [OR] or surgical removal of one ovary.
EC5: Previous exposure to cytotoxic drugs [OR] or pelvic irradiation.
EC6: Oral hypoglycemic [OR] or hormonal therapy either currently or in the preceding 3 months.
